{{Quote|Adiik, one more round, then close me out.|[[Teroch/Legends|Teroch]]|<ref name="FLT" />}}
"'''Adiik'''" was the nickname of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Vlemoth Port/Legends|Vlemoth Port]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="FLT" /> The nickname originated from the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] word ''adiik'', meaning "kid" in the Mandalorian [[Language/Legends|language]],<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref> given to the young man on account of his age. Nevertheless, Adiik worked as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] at the [[Sheb Niktose]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the Mandalorian [[City/Legends|settlement]] of [[Arumorut/Legends|Arumorut]], where he served [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverages&mdash;including [[Glass/Legends|glasses]] of [[Black ale/Legends|''ne'tra gal'']], [[Kri'gee/Legends|''kri'gee'']] and ''[[Tihaar/Legends|tihaar]]''&mdash;to customers from behind the bar.<ref name="FLT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mandalorian known as Adiik was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Age of Rebellion'']] adventure book ''[[Friends Like These]]'', published [[December 8]], [[2016]].<ref name="FLT" />
